components.title: From question to visual answer
components.subtitle: A communication channel, not a separate application (synthetic example)

components.text: The agent chooses the structure that conveys the answer. A complete explanation needs no live data.

components.title: Small grammar. Rich expression.
components.text: Fixed elements, typed data and local interaction. No source registration, job or monitoring deadline.

steps.label: Understand the question
steps.text: Decide whether prose, a comparison, or a visual explanation best serves the answer.

steps.label: Gather and prepare evidence
steps.text: Use ordinary research and analysis tools. Preserve what is known, missing and calculated.

steps.label: Compose a small visual answer
steps.text: Pick typed elements. Bind data. Let the renderer handle typography, layout and inspection.

steps.label: Publish into the conversation
steps.text: The answer is complete. Reading a source or polling is optional, never required.
